ValidationRule.description: When an agent is trying to close the case manually if the Sub status is not equal to Approved, Declined, Completed, Expired, Cancelled
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c = false, TEXT(Region_Flag__c) == 'Bahrain', ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Declined")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Completed")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Expired")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Cancelled")) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase Application") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot perform this action to close the case, Please contact the Administrator.
